item.title: Jensen Huang: Grit, character and building NVIDIA
item.description: NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang in a candid chat with longtime friend Jodi Shelton on A Bit Personal (4 Oct 2026). Stitched to about 29 minutes: schlepping CUDA to rooms of three people, why he earns his job every day, Grace Blackwell nearly breaking the company, his childhood in Kentucky (the hanging bridge and cleaning bathrooms), and why he thinks AI will make us busier, not jobless. Source clips from the full 87 minute episode: 00:00 to 05:21, 09:23 to 15:13, 23:42 to 29:03, 42:40 to 49:17, 55:06 to 61:04. Full episode: https://www.abitpersonalpod.com/p/jensen-huang-founder-and-ceo-of-nvidia-160

item.title: Inside Anthropic: Sholto Douglas and Nick Marwell on where AI is heading
item.description: Two Anthropic reinforcement learning leads on Joe Lonsdale's American Optimist (2 Oct 2026). Stitched about 28 min: how they got into AI, what they are building, whether we are near AGI, why biology is next, career advice for the decade of the generalists (00:00 to 19:10), then whether a post-scarcity world is achievable (39:50 to 48:30 of the original). Source: https://blog.joelonsdale.com/p/ep-164-inside-anthropic-with-sholto

item.title: Tibo Sottiaux: OpenAI Head of ChatGPT on the next era of AI
item.description: Lenny Rachitsky talks with Tibo Sottiaux, who leads ChatGPT and Codex at OpenAI, about always-on agents, Dots, which skills matter more in the AI era, and how OpenAI ships. item.title: Paige Bailey: Build Everyday Apps With Gemini (No Code)
